entries.title: Proverbs 13:1
segments: A wise son [heareth] his father's instruction; But a scoffer heareth not rebuke.

entries.title: Proverbs 13:2
segments: A man shall eat good by the fruit of his mouth; But the soul of the treacherous [shall eat] violence.

entries.title: Proverbs 13:3
segments: He that guardeth his mouth keepeth his life; [But] he that openeth wide his lips shall have destruction.

entries.title: Proverbs 13:4
segments: The soul of the sluggard desireth, and hath nothing; But the soul of the diligent shall be made fat.

entries.title: Proverbs 13:5
segments: A righteous man hateth lying; But a wicked man is loathsome, and cometh to shame.

entries.title: Proverbs 13:6
segments: Righteousness guardeth him that is upright in the way; But wickedness overthroweth the sinner.

entries.title: Proverbs 13:7
segments: There is that maketh himself rich, yet hath nothing: There is that maketh himself poor, yet hath great wealth.

entries.title: Proverbs 13:8
segments: The ransom of a man's life is his riches; But the poor heareth no threatening.

entries.title: Proverbs 13:9
segments: The light of the righteous rejoiceth; But the lamp of the wicked shall be put out.

entries.title: Proverbs 13:10
segments: By pride cometh only contention; But with the well-advised is wisdom.

entries.title: Proverbs 13:11
segments: Wealth gotten by vanity shall be diminished; But he that gathereth by labor shall have increase.

entries.title: Proverbs 13:12
segments: Hope deferred maketh the heart sick; But when the desire cometh, it is a tree of life.

entries.title: Proverbs 13:13
segments: Whoso despiseth the word bringeth destruction on himself; But he that feareth the commandment shall be rewarded.

entries.title: Proverbs 13:14
segments: The law of the wise is a fountain of life, That one may depart from the snares of death.

entries.title: Proverbs 13:15
segments: Good understanding giveth favor; But the way of the transgressor is hard.

entries.title: Proverbs 13:16
segments: Every prudent man worketh with knowledge; But a fool flaunteth [his] folly.

entries.title: Proverbs 13:17
segments: A wicked messenger falleth into evil; But a faithful ambassador is health.

entries.title: Proverbs 13:18
segments: Poverty and shame [shall be to] him that refuseth correction; But he that regardeth reproof shall be honored.

entries.title: Proverbs 13:19
segments: The desire accomplished is sweet to the soul; But it is an abomination to fools to depart from evil.

entries.title: Proverbs 13:20
segments: Walk with wise men, and thou shalt be wise; But the companion of fools shall smart for it.

entries.title: Proverbs 13:21
segments: Evil pursueth sinners; But the righteous shall be recompensed with good.

entries.title: Proverbs 13:22
segments: A good man leaveth an inheritance to his children's children; And the wealth of the sinner is laid up for the righteous.

entries.title: Proverbs 13:23
segments: Much food [is in] the tillage of the poor; But there is that is destroyed by reason of injustice.

entries.title: Proverbs 13:24
segments: He that spareth his rod hateth his son; But he that loveth him chasteneth him betimes.

entries.title: Proverbs 13:25
segments: The righteous eateth to the satisfying of his soul; But the belly of the wicked shall want.
